zh.title: 辨认导数定义
zh.prompt: 设函数 f 在 $x_{0}$ 的某邻域内有定义。下列极限中，若存在，哪一个等于 $f'(x_{0})$？

knowledge: 导数是函数增量与自变量增量之比的极限
solution.analysis: 把每个选项与导数的增量定义逐项比较。正确的差商必须同时具有基点 $x_{0}$、函数值之差和同一个自变量增量 $\Delta x$。
steps: 令自变量从 $x_{0}$ 变到 $x_{0}+\Delta x$，则自变量增量是 $\Delta x$。
相应的函数增量是 $\Delta y=f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})$，所以差商为 $\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$。
当 $\Delta x\to 0$ 时，若差商具有有限极限，该极限按定义就是 $f'(x_{0})$。
A 与上述定义完全一致；B、C 的分母不是相应增量，D 的分子也不是函数增量。
pitfalls: 把 $x_{0}$ 或 x 当作差商的分母
忘记函数增量是新函数值减去旧函数值
solution.verification: 取 $f(x)=x^{2}$、$x_{0}=1$，A 给出 $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{2\Delta x+\Delta x^{2}}{\Delta x}=2$，与已知斜率一致；其余形式不能稳定给出 2。
solution.takeaway: 认准“同一增量”：分子比较 $x_{0}+\Delta x$ 与 $x_{0}$，分母就是 $\Delta x$。
solution.extension: 把 $\Delta x$ 换成 $x-x_{0}$，可将定义等价写成 $\lim_{x\to x_{0}}\frac{f(x)-f(x_{0})}{x-x_{0}}$。

en.title: Recognizing the Definition of a Derivative
en.prompt: Suppose f is defined in a neighborhood of $x_{0}$. Which limit, if it exists, equals $f'(x_{0})$?

knowledge: a derivative is the limit of a function increment divided by the corresponding input increment
solution.analysis: Compare every option with the increment definition. A valid difference quotient must use the base point $x_{0}$, the difference of the two function values, and the same input increment $\Delta x$.
steps: When the input changes from $x_{0}$ to $x_{0}+\Delta x$, its increment is $\Delta x$.
The corresponding function increment is $\Delta y=f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})$, so the difference quotient is $\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$.
If this quotient has a finite limit as $\Delta x\to 0$, that limit is $f'(x_{0})$ by definition.
Option A matches the definition exactly; B and C use the wrong denominator, while D does not use a function increment.
pitfalls: using $x_{0}$ or x instead of the corresponding input increment
forgetting that the function increment is new value minus old value
solution.verification: For $f(x)=x^{2}$ and $x_{0}=1, A$ gives $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{2\Delta x+\Delta x^{2}}{\Delta x}=2$, the expected slope; the other forms do not reliably produce 2.
solution.takeaway: Track one consistent increment: compare $x_{0}+\Delta x$ with $x_{0}$ in the numerator and divide by $\Delta x$.
solution.extension: Writing $\Delta x=x-x_{0}$ gives the equivalent form $\lim_{x\to x_{0}}\frac{f(x)-f(x_{0})}{x-x_{0}}$.

zh.title: 用极限表示瞬时速度
zh.prompt: 质点沿直线运动，位置为 $s=s(t)$。它在 $t=3$ 时的瞬时速度可写为 $v(3)=\underline{\qquad}$。

knowledge: 平均速度是位置增量除以时间增量
瞬时速度是平均速度的极限
位置函数对时间的导数
solution.analysis: 先写从时刻 3 到 $3+\Delta t$ 的平均速度，再令时间间隔缩短到 0；不能把位置本身或路程与瞬时速度混淆。
steps: 在时间区间 $[3,3+\Delta t]$ 上，时间增量为 $\Delta t$。
这段时间内的位置增量为 $s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)$。
相应平均速度为 $\frac{s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)}{\Delta t}$，其中 $\Delta t\ne 0$。
令 $\Delta t\to 0$，若极限存在，就得到 $v(3)=\lim_{\Delta t\to 0}\frac{s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)}{\Delta t}$。
pitfalls: 把 $\frac{s(3)}{3}$ 当作瞬时速度
分子误写成 $s(\Delta t)-s(3)$
遗漏 $\Delta t\to 0$ 的极限过程
solution.verification: 若 $s(t)=2t+1$，则差商恒为 2，极限也为 2，符合匀速运动的速度。
solution.takeaway: 瞬时变化率来自“先求有限区间平均变化率，再让区间长度趋于 0”。

en.title: Expressing Instantaneous Velocity as a Limit
en.prompt: A particle moves along a line with position $s=s(t)$. Its instantaneous velocity at $t=3$ can be written as $v(3)=\underline{\qquad}$.

knowledge: average velocity is position increment divided by time increment
instantaneous velocity is a limit of average velocities
the derivative of position with respect to time
solution.analysis: First write the average velocity from time 3 to $3+\Delta t$, then shrink the time interval to 0. Position itself must not be confused with velocity.
steps: On the time interval $[3,3+\Delta t]$, the time increment is $\Delta t$.
The corresponding position increment is $s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)$.
Thus the average velocity is $\frac{s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)}{\Delta t}$ for $\Delta t\ne 0$.
Letting $\Delta t\to 0$ gives $v(3)=\lim_{\Delta t\to 0}\frac{s(3+\Delta t)-s(3)}{\Delta t}$ whenever the limit exists.
pitfalls: using $\frac{s(3)}{3}$ as the instantaneous velocity
writing $s(\Delta t)-s(3)$ in the numerator
omitting the limiting process $\Delta t\to 0$
solution.verification: If $s(t)=2t+1$, the quotient is identically 2, so its limit is 2, as expected for constant velocity.
solution.takeaway: An instantaneous rate is obtained by first forming an average rate over a finite interval and then shrinking the interval to zero.
solution.extension: Replacing 3 by an arbitrary $t_{0}$ gives the definition $v(t_{0})=s'(t_{0})$.

zh.title: 在非零点由定义求导
zh.prompt: 仅用导数定义求 $f(x)=x^{2}$ 在 $x=2$ 处的导数。

solution.analysis: 把 $x_{0}=2$ 直接代入差商。先展开并提取 $\Delta x$，再在 $\Delta x\ne 0$ 时约分，最后才能令 $\Delta x\to 0$。
steps: 按定义，$f'(2)=\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{(2+\Delta x)^{2}-2^{2}}{\Delta x}$。
展开分子：$(2+\Delta x)^{2}-4=4\Delta x+(\Delta x)^{2}$。
在取极限的穿孔邻域内 $\Delta x\ne 0$，所以差商化为 $\frac{4\Delta x+(\Delta x)^{2}}{\Delta x}=4+\Delta x$。
令 $\Delta x\to 0$，得到 $f'(2)=\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}(4+\Delta x)=4$。
pitfalls: 一开始就令 $\Delta x=0$，造成 $\frac{0}{0}$
漏掉展开式中的 $4\Delta x$
solution.verification: 函数图像 $y=x^{2}$ 在 $x=2$ 附近上升；对称差商 $\frac{f(2+h)-f(2-h)}{2h}=4$，也给出相同结果。
solution.takeaway: 定义求导的标准流程是：列差商、代数化简、约去增量、再取极限。
solution.extension: 把 2 换成任意 a，同样计算可得 $f'(a)=2a$。

en.title: Differentiate at a Nonzero Point from First Principles
en.prompt: Using only the definition of the derivative, find the derivative of $f(x)=x^{2}$ at $x=2$.

knowledge: canceling a nonzero increment before taking a limit
solution.analysis: Insert $x_{0}=2$ into the difference quotient. Expand and factor out $\Delta x$, cancel it while $\Delta x\ne 0$, and only then let $\Delta x$ approach 0.
steps: By definition, $f'(2)=\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{(2+\Delta x)^{2}-2^{2}}{\Delta x}$.
Expand the numerator: $(2+\Delta x)^{2}-4=4\Delta x+(\Delta x)^{2}$.
In the punctured neighborhood used by the limit, $\Delta x\ne 0$, so the quotient becomes $\frac{4\Delta x+(\Delta x)^{2}}{\Delta x}=4+\Delta x$.
Letting $\Delta x\to 0$ yields $f'(2)=\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}(4+\Delta x)=4$.
pitfalls: substituting $\Delta x=0$ at the beginning and obtaining $\frac{0}{0}$
omitting the term $4\Delta x$
confusing $f'(2)$ with $f(2)$
solution.verification: The graph $y=x^{2}$ rises near $x=2$. Moreover, the symmetric quotient $\frac{f(2+h)-f(2-h)}{2h}=4$ confirms the same value.
solution.takeaway: The first-principles pattern is: form the quotient, simplify algebraically, cancel the increment, and then take the limit.
solution.extension: Replacing 2 by an arbitrary a gives $f'(a)=2a$ by the same calculation.

zh.title: 可导是否保证连续
zh.prompt: 判断正误并说明理由：若 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处可导，则 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处连续。

knowledge: 有限极限与无穷小的乘积
solution.analysis: 要证明连续，只需证明 $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})\to 0$。把函数增量写成差商与 $\Delta x$ 的乘积即可直接使用导数存在。
steps: f 在 $x_{0}$ 处可导意味着 $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}=f'(x_{0})$，且该极限有限。
对 $\Delta x\ne 0$，有 $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})={\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}}\cdot \Delta x$。
当 $\Delta x\to 0$ 时，第一个因子趋于有限数 $f'(x_{0})$，第二个因子趋于 0。
因此函数增量趋于 0，即 $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}f(x_{0}+\Delta x)=f(x_{0})$，所以 f 在 $x_{0}$ 连续。
pitfalls: 把结论错误地反向使用为连续必可导
没有说明导数极限必须是有限值
solution.verification: 证明直接得到连续性的增量判据 $\Delta y\to 0$，没有额外假设，因此原命题正确。
solution.takeaway: 可导比连续更强；导数存在时，函数增量必然能够写成“有限量乘无穷小”。
solution.extension: 连续的逆命题不成立；例如 $f(x)=|x|$ 在 0 连续但不可导。

en.title: Does Differentiability Guarantee Continuity?
en.prompt: Decide whether the statement is true and justify: if f is differentiable at $x_{0}$, then f is continuous at $x_{0}$.

knowledge: a finite limit times an infinitesimal
solution.analysis: To prove continuity, it is enough to show $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})\to 0$. Factor this increment into the difference quotient and $\Delta x$, then use the existence of the derivative.
steps: Differentiability at $x_{0}$ means $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}=f'(x_{0})$, and this limit is finite.
For $\Delta x\ne 0$, write $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})={\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}}\cdot \Delta x$.
As $\Delta x\to 0$, the first factor tends to the finite number $f'(x_{0})$, while the second tends to 0.
Hence the function increment tends to 0, so $\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}f(x_{0}+\Delta x)=f(x_{0})$; therefore f is continuous at $x_{0}$.
pitfalls: reversing the implication and claiming that continuity guarantees differentiability
failing to note that a derivative is a finite limit
solution.verification: The argument establishes the increment criterion $\Delta y\to 0$ for continuity without any extra assumption, so the statement is true.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability is stronger than continuity: the function increment becomes a finite quantity times an infinitesimal.
solution.extension: The converse is false; for example, $f(x)=|x|$ is continuous but not differentiable at 0.

zh.title: 由导数写切线方程

solution.analysis: 切线必须经过给定切点 $(2,5)$，斜率是 $f'(2)=-3$。将这两个信息直接代入点斜式。
steps: 导数的几何意义给出该点切线斜率 $k=f'(2)=-3$。
直线经过 $(x_{0},y_{0})$ 且斜率为 k 时，点斜式为 $y-y_{0}=k(x-x_{0})$。
代入得到 $y-5=-3(x-2)$，故选择 A。
pitfalls: 交换切点的横、纵坐标
把法线斜率 $-\frac{1}{k}$ 当成切线斜率
点斜式中符号写反
solution.verification: 令 $x=2$，A 给出 $y=5$，确实经过切点；其斜率也恰为 $-3$。
solution.takeaway: 切线方程只需要两个量：切点 $(x_{0},f(x_{0}))$ 与斜率 $f'(x_{0})$。
solution.extension: 该点法线斜率为 $\frac{1}{3}$，法线方程为 $y-5=(\frac{1}{3})(x-2)$。

en.title: Writing a Tangent Line from a Derivative
en.prompt: Suppose $f(2)=5$ and $f'(2)=-3$. Which equation is the tangent line to $y=f(x)$ at $(2,5)$?

knowledge: a derivative is the tangent slope
coordinates of the point of tangency
solution.analysis: The tangent must pass through $(2,5)$, and its slope is $f'(2)=-3$. Insert these data into point-slope form.
steps: The point on the curve corresponding to $x=2$ is $(2,f(2))=(2,5)$.
By the geometric meaning of a derivative, the tangent slope is $k=f'(2)=-3$.
A line through $(x_{0},y_{0})$ with slope k has point-slope form $y-y_{0}=k(x-x_{0})$.
Substitution gives $y-5=-3(x-2)$, so A is correct.
pitfalls: interchanging the coordinates of the point
using the normal slope $-\frac{1}{k}$ for the tangent
reversing signs in point-slope form
solution.verification: Setting $x=2$ in A gives $y=5$, so it passes through the required point, and its slope is exactly $-3$.
solution.takeaway: A tangent line needs two pieces of information: $(x_{0},f(x_{0}))$ and the slope $f'(x_{0})$.
solution.extension: The normal slope is $\frac{1}{3}$, so the normal line is $y-5=(\frac{1}{3})(x-2)$.

zh.title: 绝对值函数的左右导数
zh.prompt: 设 $f(x)=|x|$。则 $f'_{-}(0)=\underline{\qquad}$，$f'_{+}(0)=\underline{\qquad}$，所以 f 在 0 处$\underline{\qquad}$（填“可导”或“不可导”）。

solution.analysis: 在 0 左右两侧分别确定 $|h|$ 的表达式。两个单侧差商虽然都有极限，但极限不相等。
steps: 由于 $-1\ne 1$，双侧导数不存在，因此 f 在 0 处不可导。
pitfalls: 把 $|h|$ 一律替换为 h
只算一个方向的导数就断言可导
误认为两个单侧导数只要有限即可
solution.verification: 图像 $y=|x|$ 在原点形成尖角；左侧斜率 $-1$、右侧斜率 1，与计算吻合。
solution.takeaway: 分段点的可导性必须逐侧检查，并要求左右导数作为数值完全相同。

en.title: One-Sided Derivatives of an Absolute-Value Function
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=|x|$. Then $f'_{-}(0)=\underline{\qquad}, f'_{+}(0)=\underline{\qquad}$, so f is $\underline{\qquad}$ at 0 (write “differentiable” or “not differentiable”).

knowledge: equality of one-sided derivatives as the differentiability criterion
solution.analysis: Determine the expression for $|h|$ separately on the two sides of 0. Both one-sided quotients have limits, but those limits are unequal.
steps: Since $f(0)=0$, the difference quotient is $\frac{f(h)-f(0)}{h}=\frac{|h|}{h}$.
Because $-1\ne 1$, the two-sided derivative does not exist, and f is not differentiable at 0.
pitfalls: replacing $|h|$ by h on both sides
checking only one one-sided derivative
assuming that two finite one-sided derivatives are sufficient even when they differ
solution.verification: The graph $y=|x|$ has a corner at the origin; its left slope is $-1$ and its right slope is 1, matching the calculation.
solution.takeaway: At a junction, check both sides and require the two one-sided derivatives to be exactly equal.
solution.extension: For $f(x)=|x-a|$, the same argument gives $f'_{-}(a)=-1$ and $f'_{+}(a)=1$.

zh.title: 由定义求切线与法线
zh.prompt: 曲线 $y=x^{2}$ 上取点 $P(1,1)$。用导数定义求 P 点的切线与法线方程。

knowledge: 互相垂直直线的斜率关系
solution.analysis: 先用差商求 $x=1$ 处的导数。切线斜率等于导数；由于切线斜率非零，法线斜率是其负倒数。
pitfalls: 把法线斜率写成 $\frac{1}{2}$ 而漏掉负号
切线和法线没有使用同一个切点
未按要求使用定义求导
solution.verification: 两条直线都经过 $(1,1)$，且斜率乘积 $2\cdot (-\frac{1}{2})=-1$，说明它们互相垂直。
solution.takeaway: 几何题的主线是“定义求斜率—点斜式写切线—负倒数写法线”。
solution.extension: 在点 $(a,a^{2})$ 处，切线斜率为 2a；当 $a=0$ 时法线是竖直直线 $x=0$。

en.title: Tangent and Normal Lines from First Principles
en.prompt: Let $P(1,1)$ lie on the curve $y=x^{2}$. Use the definition of the derivative to find the tangent and normal lines at P.

solution.analysis: First find the derivative at $x=1$ from the difference quotient. The tangent slope equals the derivative, and because it is nonzero, the normal slope is its negative reciprocal.
steps: By definition, $f'(1)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{(1+h)^{2}-1^{2}}{h}$.
Expand and cancel: $\frac{(1+h)^{2}-1}{h}=\frac{2h+h^{2}}{h}=2+h$, so $f'(1)=2$.
The tangent passes through $(1,1)$ with slope 2, hence $y-1=2(x-1)$, or $y=2x-1$.
The normal slope is $-\frac{1}{2}$, hence $y-1=-(\frac{1}{2})(x-1)$, or $y=-(\frac{1}{2})x+\frac{3}{2}$.
pitfalls: using $\frac{1}{2}$ instead of $-\frac{1}{2}$ for the normal slope
using different points for the tangent and normal
not using first principles as requested
solution.verification: Both lines pass through $(1,1)$, and their slopes satisfy $2\cdot (-\frac{1}{2})=-1$, confirming perpendicularity.
solution.takeaway: The geometric workflow is: obtain the slope from first principles, write the tangent in point-slope form, then take the negative reciprocal for the normal.
solution.extension: At $(a,a^{2})$, the tangent slope is 2a; when $a=0$, the normal is the vertical line $x=0$.

zh.title: 选择对数函数的导数
zh.prompt: 在 $x>0$ 上，函数 $y=\ln x$ 的导数为（ ）。

knowledge: 自然对数的基本求导公式
solution.analysis: 直接调用基本公式 $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$，并保留原题给出的定义域 $x>0$。
steps: 自然对数 $\ln x$ 的实数定义域是 $x>0$。
基本求导公式给出 $\frac{d(\ln x)}{dx}=\frac{1}{x}$。
因此 $y'=\frac{1}{x}$，且该表达式在 $x>0$ 上有意义。
A 正确；B 把原函数当成导数，C、D 分别属于其他函数的形式。
pitfalls: 把 $(\ln x)'$ 误写成 $\ln x$
忽略 $x>0$ 的定义域
solution.verification: 当 $x=1$ 时，公式给出 $y'=1$；$\ln x$ 在 1 附近的差商极限也等于 1。
solution.takeaway: 记忆基本公式时要把函数、导数和适用定义域作为一个整体。
solution.extension: 由链式法则可进一步得到 $(\ln u(x))'=\frac{u'(x)}{u(x)}$，前提是 $u(x)>0$。

en.title: Choose the Derivative of a Logarithm
en.prompt: For $x>0$, what is the derivative of $y=\ln x$?

knowledge: basic derivative formula for the natural logarithm
distinguishing a function from its derivative
solution.analysis: Apply the basic formula $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ and retain the stated domain $x>0$.
steps: The real-valued natural logarithm $\ln x$ has domain $x>0$.
The basic derivative formula is $\frac{d(\ln x)}{dx}=\frac{1}{x}$.
Therefore $y'=\frac{1}{x}$, which is defined throughout $x>0$.
Thus A is correct; B repeats the original function, while C and D belong to different formulas.
pitfalls: writing $(\ln x)'=\ln x$
ignoring the domain $x>0$
confusing the formula with $(e^{x})'=e^{x}$
solution.verification: At $x=1$ the formula gives $y'=1$, which agrees with the difference-quotient limit of $\ln x$ at 1.
solution.takeaway: Learn each basic formula together with the function, its derivative, and its domain.
solution.extension: The chain rule gives $(\ln u(x))'=\frac{u'(x)}{u(x)}$, provided $u(x)>0$.

zh.title: 倒数函数在任意非零点的导数
zh.prompt: 设 $f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$。对任意 $a\ne 0$，仅用导数定义求 $f'(a)$。

solution.analysis: 在 a 处写出差商后先通分。由于 $a\ne 0$，并且 h 足够小时 $a+h\ne 0$，差商可合法化简。
steps: 按定义，$f'(a)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{a+h}-\frac{1}{a}}{h}$。
分子通分得到 $\frac{1}{a+h}-\frac{1}{a}=\frac{a-(a+h)}{a(a+h)}=-\frac{h}{a(a+h)}$。
对 $h\ne 0$，差商化为 $\frac{{-\frac{h}{a(a+h)}}}{h}=-\frac{1}{a(a+h)}$。
令 $h\to 0$，由 $a\ne 0$ 得 $f'(a)=-\frac{1}{a\cdot a}=-\frac{1}{a^{2}}$。
pitfalls: 通分时把分子符号写反
约去 h 后忘记负号
漏写 $a\ne 0$ 以及 $a+h\ne 0$ 的条件
solution.verification: 取 $a=1$，结果为 $-1$；当 x 从 1 略微增大时 $\frac{1}{x}$ 减小，导数为负与变化方向一致。
solution.takeaway: 分式函数的定义求导常靠通分制造可约去的增量因子。
solution.extension: 用同一方法可证明 $(\frac{c}{x})'=-\frac{c}{x^{2}}$，其中 c 为常数。

en.title: Derivative of the Reciprocal Function at Any Nonzero Point
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$. For any $a\ne 0$, use only the definition of the derivative to find $f'(a)$.

knowledge: derivative definition at a nonzero point
solution.analysis: Write the difference quotient at a and combine the fractions. Since $a\ne 0$ and $a+h\ne 0$ for all sufficiently small h, the algebraic simplification is legitimate.
steps: By definition, $f'(a)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{a+h}-\frac{1}{a}}{h}$.
Combine the numerator: $\frac{1}{a+h}-\frac{1}{a}=\frac{a-(a+h)}{a(a+h)}=-\frac{h}{a(a+h)}$.
For $h\ne 0$, the quotient simplifies to $\frac{{-\frac{h}{a(a+h)}}}{h}=-\frac{1}{a(a+h)}$.
Let $h\to 0$. Since $a\ne 0, f'(a)=-\frac{1}{a\cdot a}=-\frac{1}{a^{2}}$.
pitfalls: reversing the sign when combining the fractions
losing the minus sign after canceling h
omitting the conditions $a\ne 0$ and $a+h\ne 0$
solution.verification: At $a=1$ the result is $-1$. As x increases slightly from $1,\frac{1}{x}$ decreases, which agrees with the negative derivative.
solution.takeaway: For rational functions, combining fractions often exposes the input increment that can be canceled.
solution.extension: The same method proves $(\frac{c}{x})'=-\frac{c}{x^{2}}$ for any constant c.

zh.title: 辨析可导性的逻辑关系
zh.prompt: 设 $x_{0}$ 是 f 定义域的内点。下列命题中正确的是哪些？
choices: B. 若 f 在 $x_{0}$ 连续，则 $f'(x_{0})$ 一定存在
C. 若 $f'(x_{0})$ 存在，则 f 在 $x_{0}$ 连续

knowledge: 双侧导数与单侧导数的关系
solution.analysis: A、D 需要比较左右导数是否相等；B、C 需要辨认“可导推出连续”的正确方向。用 $|x-x_{0}|$ 可以同时否定两个常见误判。
steps: 若双侧差商极限 $f'(x_{0})$ 存在，则其左、右极限必存在并等于同一个值，所以 A 正确。
可导蕴含连续，因此 C 正确。
函数 $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|$ 在 $x_{0}$ 连续，但左、右导数分别为 $-1$ 与 1，所以 B 错误。
同一反例中两个单侧导数都是有限数却不相等，双侧导数不存在，所以 D 错误。
pitfalls: 把必要条件和充分条件互换
只要求左右导数有限而忘记要求相等
把连续与可导当成等价概念
solution.verification: $|x-x_{0}|$ 的函数值在 $x_{0}$ 连续，而差商从左、右分别恒趋于 $-1$、1，精确验证了反例。
solution.takeaway: 内点可导等价于左右导数都存在且相等；连续只是可导的必要条件。
solution.extension: 若 $x_{0}$ 是定义域端点，通常只讨论沿定义域方向的单侧导数，而不是双侧导数。

en.title: Logical Relations Involving Differentiability
en.prompt: Let $x_{0}$ be an interior point of the domain of f. Which statements are correct?
choices: A. If $f'(x_{0})$ exists, then $f'_{-}(x_{0})$ and $f'_{+}(x_{0})$ both exist and are equal
B. If f is continuous at $x_{0}$, then $f'(x_{0})$ must exist
C. If $f'(x_{0})$ exists, then f is continuous at $x_{0}$
D. If $f'_{-}(x_{0})$ and $f'_{+}(x_{0})$ are both finite, then $f'(x_{0})$ must exist

knowledge: relation between two-sided and one-sided derivatives
solution.analysis: For A and D, equality of the one-sided derivatives is decisive. For B and C, identify the correct direction of the implication from differentiability to continuity. The function $|x-x_{0}|$ rejects both common false claims.
steps: If the two-sided difference-quotient limit $f'(x_{0})$ exists, its left and right limits exist and equal that same value; thus A is true.
Differentiability implies continuity, so C is true.
The function $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|$ is continuous at $x_{0}$, but its left and right derivatives are $-1$ and 1; hence B is false.
In the same example both one-sided derivatives are finite but unequal, so the two-sided derivative does not exist; hence D is false.
pitfalls: interchanging a necessary condition and a sufficient condition
requiring the one-sided derivatives to be finite but not equal
treating continuity and differentiability as equivalent
solution.verification: For $|x-x_{0}|$, continuity at $x_{0}$ is immediate, while the left and right quotients tend exactly to $-1$ and 1, validating the counterexample.
solution.takeaway: At an interior point, differentiability is equivalent to existence and equality of both one-sided derivatives; continuity is only necessary.
solution.extension: At an endpoint of the domain, one normally studies the one-sided derivative from within the domain rather than a two-sided derivative.

zh.title: 用无穷小余项证明可导必连续
zh.prompt: 已知 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处可导。证明存在 $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$，使 $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})=f'(x_{0})\Delta x+\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$，并由此证明 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处连续。
zh.answer: 令 $\alpha (\Delta x)=\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}-f'(x_{0})$（$\Delta x\ne 0$），并令 $\alpha (0)=0$，即得所需表示和连续性。

solution.analysis: 从差商趋于 $f'(x_{0})$ 出发，把二者之差命名为 $\alpha (\Delta x)$。这个误差趋于 0，乘回 $\Delta x$ 后得到函数增量的线性主部。
steps: 因 f 在 $x_{0}$ 可导，$\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}=f'(x_{0})$。
当 $\Delta x\ne 0$ 时定义 $\alpha (\Delta x)=\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}-f'(x_{0})$，并补充定义 $\alpha (0)=0$。
由导数极限立刻得到 $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$；移项并乘以 $\Delta x$，得到 $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})=f'(x_{0})\Delta x+\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$。
当 $\Delta x\to 0$ 时，$f'(x_{0})\Delta x\to 0$，且 $\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x\to 0$，所以函数增量趋于 0，f 在 $x_{0}$ 连续。
pitfalls: 只写增量公式却不构造 $\alpha$
没有证明 $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$
把 $\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$ 错写成与 $\Delta x$ 无关的常数
solution.verification: 将所得表达式除以 $\Delta x$（$\Delta x\ne 0$），又回到差商$=f'(x_{0})+\alpha (\Delta x)$，其极限确为 $f'(x_{0})$。
solution.takeaway: 可导的核心不仅是连续，还意味着函数增量具有线性主部 $f'(x_{0})\Delta x$ 和更小的余项。
solution.extension: 这一增量表示也是后续定义微分 $\Delta y=A\Delta x+o(\Delta x)$ 的直接基础。

en.title: Prove Differentiability Implies Continuity via an Infinitesimal Remainder
en.prompt: Suppose f is differentiable at $x_{0}$. Prove that some $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$ satisfies $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})=f'(x_{0})\Delta x+\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$, and use it to prove continuity at $x_{0}$.
en.answer: For $\Delta x\ne 0$, set $\alpha (\Delta x)=\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}-f'(x_{0})$, and set $\alpha (0)=0$. This gives the representation and continuity.

solution.analysis: Start from the difference quotient tending to $f'(x_{0})$, and name its error $\alpha (\Delta x)$. This error tends to 0; multiplying back by $\Delta x$ gives the linear principal part of the function increment.
steps: Because f is differentiable at $x_{0},\lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}=f'(x_{0})$.
For $\Delta x\ne 0$ define $\alpha (\Delta x)=\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}-f'(x_{0})$, and complete the definition by setting $\alpha (0)=0$.
The derivative limit immediately gives $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$. Rearranging and multiplying by $\Delta x$ yields $f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})=f'(x_{0})\Delta x+\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$.
As $\Delta x\to 0$, both $f'(x_{0})\Delta x$ and $\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$ tend to 0, so the function increment tends to 0 and f is continuous at $x_{0}$.
pitfalls: stating the increment formula without constructing $\alpha$
failing to prove $\alpha (\Delta x)\to 0$
treating $\alpha (\Delta x)\Delta x$ as a constant independent of $\Delta x$
solution.verification: Dividing the representation by $\Delta x$ for $\Delta x\ne 0$ recovers the quotient $f'(x_{0})+\alpha (\Delta x)$, whose limit is indeed $f'(x_{0})$.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability provides more than continuity: the function increment has a linear principal part $f'(x_{0})\Delta x$ and a smaller remainder.
solution.extension: This representation directly motivates the later definition of a differential through $\Delta y=A\Delta x+o(\Delta x)$.

zh.title: 连接点的参数匹配
zh.prompt: 设 $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2},&x\le 1,\\ax+b,&x>1.\end{cases}$ 求 $a,b$，使 $f$ 在 $x=1$ 处可导，并求 $f'(1)$。

solution.analysis: 可导必须先连续，再要求左右导数相等。连续条件决定 $a+b$，斜率匹配条件决定 a。
steps: 由左段及函数定义，$f(1)=1$；右极限为 $\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}(ax+b)=a+b$。
连续性要求 $a+b=1$，这是可导的必要条件。
令左右导数相等得 $a=2$，再由 $a+b=1$ 得 $b=-1$；共同导数为 $f'(1)=2$。
pitfalls: 只匹配两段公式的函数值而不匹配斜率
在求右导数前漏用 $a+b=1$，导致差商中出现常数项
把 $a+b=1$ 写成 $a-b=1$
solution.verification: 代入 $a=2$、$b=-1$，右段为 $2x-1$，在 $x=1$ 取值 1、斜率 2，与左段 $x^{2}$ 的值和斜率都一致。
solution.takeaway: 分段函数在连接点可导需要两层匹配：先匹配函数值，再匹配左右斜率。
solution.extension: 若只要求连续，则所有满足 $a+b=1$ 的参数都可以，不必要求 $a=2$。

en.title: Matching Parameters at a Junction
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2},&x\le 1,\\ax+b,&x>1.\end{cases}$ Find $a,b$ so that $f$ is differentiable at $x=1$, and find $f'(1)$.

solution.analysis: Differentiability first requires continuity and then equality of the one-sided derivatives. Continuity determines $a+b$, while slope matching determines a.
steps: From the left branch and the definition, $f(1)=1$; the right-hand limit is $\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}(ax+b)=a+b$.
Continuity requires $a+b=1$, which is necessary for differentiability.
The left derivative is $\lim_{h\to 0^{-}}\frac{(1+h)^{2}-1}{h}=2$. Using $a+b=1$, the right derivative is $\lim_{h\to 0^{+}}\frac{a(1+h)+b-1}{h}=a$.
Equality of the one-sided derivatives gives $a=2$; then $a+b=1$ gives $b=-1$, and $f'(1)=2$.
pitfalls: matching function values but not slopes
finding the right derivative without first using $a+b=1$, leaving a constant term in the quotient
writing $a-b=1$ instead of $a+b=1$
solution.verification: With $a=2$ and $b=-1$, the right branch is $2x-1$, which has value 1 and slope 2 at $x=1$, matching the left branch $x^{2}$.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability at a piecewise junction requires two matches: function values first, then one-sided slopes.
solution.extension: If only continuity were required, every pair satisfying $a+b=1$ would work; $a=2$ would not be necessary.

zh.title: 求指定时刻的瞬时速度
zh.prompt: 质点的位置为 $s(t)=t^{3}-6t^{2}+9t$（m），t 以 s 为单位。用差商极限求 $t=2$ 时的瞬时速度 $v(2)=\underline{\qquad}$。

solution.analysis: 按定义计算 $\frac{s(2+h)-s(2)}{h}$。展开后常数项应完全抵消，留下可约去的 h。
steps: 令 $h\to 0$，得到 $v(2)=\lim_{h\to 0}(-3+h^{2})=-3\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$；负号表示此刻沿选定正方向的反方向运动。
pitfalls: 把位置 $s(2)=2\,\mathrm{m}$ 当成速度
展开多项式时漏掉交叉项
答案遗漏速度单位或误解负号
solution.verification: 也可先由基本规则得到 $s'(t)=3t^{2}-12t+9$，代入 $t=2$ 得 $-3$，与定义计算一致。
solution.takeaway: 瞬时速度是位置关于时间的导数，数值的正负描述方向而不是速率的大小。
solution.extension: 在 $t=2$ 附近的平均速度为 $-3+h^{2}$；当 h 很小时，它确实接近 $-3\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$。

en.title: Instantaneous Velocity at a Specified Time
en.prompt: A particle has position $s(t)=t^{3}-6t^{2}+9t$ meters, with t in seconds. Use a difference-quotient limit to find the instantaneous velocity at $t=2$, namely $v(2)=\underline{\qquad}$.

knowledge: directional meaning of a negative sign
solution.analysis: Compute $\frac{s(2+h)-s(2)}{h}$ from the definition. After expansion, all constant terms should cancel, leaving a factor h.
steps: The average-velocity quotient is $\frac{s(2+h)-s(2)}{h}=\frac{-3h+h^{3}}{h}=-3+h^{2}$.
Letting $h\to 0$ gives $v(2)=\lim_{h\to 0}(-3+h^{2})=-3\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$; the negative sign indicates motion opposite the chosen positive direction.
pitfalls: using the position $s(2)=2\,\mathrm{m}$ as the velocity
omitting cross terms in the expansion
dropping the velocity unit or misreading the negative sign
solution.verification: The basic rules also give $s'(t)=3t^{2}-12t+9$, and substitution $t=2$ gives $-3$, matching the first-principles result.
solution.takeaway: Instantaneous velocity is the derivative of position with respect to time; its sign records direction, not merely speed.
solution.extension: The average velocity near $t=2$ is $-3+h^{2}$, which approaches $-3\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ for small h.

zh.title: 根式曲线的切线与法线
zh.prompt: 不用现成求导公式，由定义求曲线 $y=\sqrt{x}$ 在点 $(4,2)$ 处的导数，并写出切线与法线方程。

solution.analysis: 差商含两个根式，乘以共轭式有理化即可约去 h。导数非零，所以法线斜率存在且为 $-\frac{1}{f'(4)}$。
steps: 按定义，$f'(4)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{4+h}-2}{h}$。
乘以共轭式，差商等于 $\frac{(4+h)-4}{{h[\sqrt{4+h}+2]}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{4+h}+2}$。
pitfalls: 有理化时只乘分子不乘分母
把 $\sqrt{4+h}$ 的极限误当成 4
法线斜率漏写负号
solution.verification: 切线与法线均经过 $(4,2)$，斜率乘积 $(\frac{1}{4})(-4)=-1$，且定义所得斜率为正，符合曲线在该点上升。
solution.takeaway: 根式差商优先用共轭式；得到切线斜率后，几何方程按点斜式完成。
solution.extension: 同样有理化可得 $(\sqrt{x})'=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}$，适用于 $x>0$。

en.title: Tangent and Normal to a Square-Root Curve
en.prompt: Without using a ready-made derivative formula, find the derivative of $y=\sqrt{x}$ at $(4,2)$ from the definition, and write the tangent and normal lines.

knowledge: normal slope as the negative reciprocal
solution.analysis: The quotient contains two radicals, so multiply by the conjugate to cancel h. The derivative is nonzero, so the normal slope exists and equals $-\frac{1}{f'(4)}$.
steps: By definition, $f'(4)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{4+h}-2}{h}$.
Rationalizing gives $\frac{(4+h)-4}{{h[\sqrt{4+h}+2]}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{4+h}+2}$.
Let $h\to 0$ to obtain $f'(4)=\frac{1}{2+2}=\frac{1}{4}$; hence the tangent is $y-2=(\frac{1}{4})(x-4)$.
The normal slope is $-4$, so the normal line is $y-2=-4(x-4)$.
pitfalls: multiplying only the numerator by the conjugate
treating the limit of $\sqrt{4+h}$ as 4
omitting the minus sign in the normal slope
solution.verification: Both lines pass through $(4,2)$, their slopes multiply to $(\frac{1}{4})(-4)=-1$, and the positive tangent slope agrees with the curve rising there.
solution.takeaway: Use the conjugate for a radical difference quotient, then convert the derivative into geometric line equations.
solution.extension: The same rationalization gives $(\sqrt{x})'=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}$ for $x>0$.

zh.title: 检验可导必连续的逆命题
zh.prompt: 判断正误并给出严格理由：若 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处连续，则 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处可导。
zh.answer: 错误；例如 $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|$ 在 $x_{0}$ 连续但不可导。

solution.analysis: 一个全称命题只需一个反例即可否定。选择在 $x_{0}$ 有尖角的绝对值函数，同时验证其连续性和不可导性。
steps: 从右侧取 $h\to 0^{+}$，差商 $\frac{|h|}{h}=1$，因此 $f'_{+}(x_{0})=1$；两者不等，f 在 $x_{0}$ 不可导，原命题错误。
pitfalls: 只画图而不计算左右导数
把“可导蕴含连续”擅自改成双向等价
反例没有验证连续性
solution.verification: 该反例对任意指定 $x_{0}$ 都成立，因此确实否定了原命题的普遍性。
solution.takeaway: 连续排除了跳跃，却没有排除尖角；因此连续只是可导的必要条件，不是充分条件。
solution.extension: $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|^{\frac{1}{2}}$ 也连续但在 $x_{0}$ 没有有限导数，呈现另一种失效方式。

en.title: Testing the Converse of Differentiability Implies Continuity
en.prompt: Decide whether the statement is true and justify rigorously: if f is continuous at $x_{0}$, then f is differentiable at $x_{0}$.
en.answer: False; for example, $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|$ is continuous but not differentiable at $x_{0}$.

solution.analysis: One counterexample disproves a universal statement. Choose an absolute-value function with a corner at $x_{0}$, and verify both continuity and failure of differentiability.
steps: As $x\to x_{0}, |x-x_{0}|\to 0=f(x_{0})$, so f is continuous at $x_{0}$.
For $h\to 0^{-}$, the quotient $\frac{|h|}{h}=-1$, so $f'_{-}(x_{0})=-1$.
For $h\to 0^{+}$, the quotient $\frac{|h|}{h}=1$, so $f'_{+}(x_{0})=1$. The values differ, so f is not differentiable at $x_{0}$ and the statement is false.
pitfalls: drawing a graph without calculating the one-sided derivatives
turning the one-way implication into an equivalence
giving a counterexample without checking continuity
solution.verification: The construction works for every prescribed $x_{0}$, so it genuinely disproves the universal claim.
solution.takeaway: Continuity excludes jumps but not corners; it is necessary, not sufficient, for differentiability.
solution.extension: The function $f(x)=|x-x_{0}|^{\frac{1}{2}}$ is also continuous but has no finite derivative at $x_{0}$, showing a different failure mode.

zh.title: 证明平移绝对值在尖点不可导
zh.prompt: 设 a 为任意实数。证明 $f(x)=|x-a|$ 在 $x=a$ 处连续，但左导数为 $-1$、右导数为 1，因而不可导。

knowledge: 平移不改变绝对值尖角结构
solution.analysis: 以 $h=x-a$ 表示对基点 a 的增量，问题就完全化为 $|h|$ 在 0 附近的行为。
steps: $f(a)=|a-a|=0$；当 $x\to a$ 时，$|x-a|\to 0$，因此 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$，f 在 a 连续。
差商为 $\frac{f(a+h)-f(a)}{h}=\frac{|h|}{h}$。
若 $h\to 0^{+}$，则 $|h|=h$，差商为 1，所以 $f'_{+}(a)=1$；两侧不等，故 $f'(a)$ 不存在。
pitfalls: 把基点 a 误认为必须等于 0
连续性验证中漏掉 $f(a)$
认为平移后尖角会消失
solution.verification: 令 $u=x-a$，图像只是 $y=|u|$ 水平平移到顶点 (a,0)，左右斜率仍分别为 $-1$、1。
solution.takeaway: 处理平移后的局部性质时，用增量 $h=x-a$ 可把基点移回 0。
solution.extension: 对 $c|x-a|+d$，若 $c\ne 0$，则在 $x=a$ 仍不可导，左右导数分别为 $-c$ 与 c。

en.title: Prove a Translated Absolute Value Is Not Differentiable at Its Corner
en.prompt: Let a be any real number. Prove that $f(x)=|x-a|$ is continuous at $x=a$, but has left derivative $-1$ and right derivative 1 there, and hence is not differentiable.
en.answer: f is continuous at a, with $f'_{-}(a)=-1$ and $f'_{+}(a)=1$, so $f'(a)$ does not exist.

knowledge: translation preserves the corner of an absolute-value graph
solution.analysis: Use $h=x-a$ as the increment from the base point a. The local problem then becomes exactly the behavior of $|h|$ near 0.
steps: Since $f(a)=|a-a|=0$ and $|x-a|\to 0$ as $x\to a, \lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$, so f is continuous at a.
The difference quotient is $\frac{f(a+h)-f(a)}{h}=\frac{|h|}{h}$.
For $h\to 0^{-}, |h|=-h$, so the quotient is $-1$ and $f'_{-}(a)=-1$.
For $h\to 0^{+}, |h|=h$, so the quotient is 1 and $f'_{+}(a)=1$. The values differ, so $f'(a)$ does not exist.
pitfalls: assuming the base point a must be 0
omitting $f(a)$ in the continuity check
thinking that translation removes the corner
solution.verification: With $u=x-a$, the graph is simply $y=|u|$ shifted so its vertex is (a,0); the one-sided slopes remain $-1$ and 1.
solution.takeaway: For a translated local property, the increment $h=x-a$ moves the base point back to 0.
solution.extension: For $c|x-a|+d$ with $c\ne 0$, differentiability still fails at $x=a$; the one-sided derivatives are $-c$ and c.

zh.title: 乘积法则与结果化简
zh.prompt: 求函数 $y=(x^{2}+1)(x^{3}-2x)$ 的导数，并将结果化为多项式。

solution.analysis: 把两个因子分别记为 u、v，使用 $(uv)'=u'v+uv'$。最后展开核对，可以避免漏掉其中一项。
pitfalls: 误写成 $u'v'$
只对一个因子求导
solution.verification: 先展开原函数 $y=x^{5}-x^{3}-2x$，再逐项求导同样得到 $5x^{4}-3x^{2}-2$。
solution.takeaway: 乘积求导保留“两项交叉结构”；能展开时可用另一条路径交叉检查。
solution.extension: 若函数含三个因子，可逐次使用乘积法则，得到每次只对一个因子求导的三项和。

en.title: Product Rule and Simplification
en.prompt: Differentiate $y=(x^{2}+1)(x^{3}-2x)$, and simplify the result to a polynomial.

solution.analysis: Name the two factors u and v and use $(uv)'=u'v+uv'$. Expanding afterward provides a useful check against a missing term.
steps: By the product rule, $y'=2x(x^{3}-2x)+(x^{2}+1)(3x^{2}-2)$.
The two expanded expressions are $2x^{4}-4x^{2}$ and $3x^{4}+x^{2}-2$.
pitfalls: writing $u'v'$
differentiating only one factor
losing the constant term $-2$ when expanding $(x^{2}+1)(3x^{2}-2)$
solution.verification: Expanding first gives $y=x^{5}-x^{3}-2x$, whose termwise derivative is also $5x^{4}-3x^{2}-2$.
solution.takeaway: A product derivative retains two cross terms; when expansion is possible, use it as an independent check.
solution.extension: For three factors, repeated use of the product rule gives a three-term sum in which one factor is differentiated at a time.

zh.title: 识别内外层并求导
zh.prompt: 若 $y=\sin(3x^{2}-1)$，则 $y'=\underline{\qquad}$。

solution.analysis: 外层是 $\sin u$，内层是 $u=3x^{2}-1$。先求外层对 u 的导数，再乘内层对 x 的导数。
steps: 外层导数为 $\frac{dy}{du}=\cos u$。
内层导数为 $\frac{du}{dx}=6x$。
由链式法则，$y'=(\frac{dy}{du})(\frac{du}{dx})=\cos(3x^{2}-1)\cdot 6x=6x \cos(3x^{2}-1)$。
pitfalls: 只写 $\cos(3x^{2}-1)$ 而漏乘 6x
把 $(\sin u)'$ 写成 $-\sin u$
将内层常数 $-1$ 错求成 $-1$
solution.verification: 在 $x=0$ 时内层的变化率为 0，公式给出 $y'(0)=0$，符合复合变化率应含内层因子。
solution.takeaway: 链式法则可记作“外层导数保留内层，再乘内层导数”。
solution.extension: 若 $y=\sin^{3}(3x^{2}-1)$，还需再增加一层幂函数链式求导。

en.title: Identify the Inner and Outer Functions
en.prompt: If $y=\sin(3x^{2}-1)$, then $y'=\underline{\qquad}$.

solution.analysis: The outer function is $\sin u$ and the inner function is $u=3x^{2}-1$. Differentiate the outer function with respect to u and multiply by the derivative of the inner function.
steps: Set $u=3x^{2}-1$, so $y=\sin u$.
The outer derivative is $\frac{dy}{du}=\cos u$.
The inner derivative is $\frac{du}{dx}=6x$.
By the chain rule, $y'=(\frac{dy}{du})(\frac{du}{dx})=\cos(3x^{2}-1)\cdot 6x=6x \cos(3x^{2}-1)$.
pitfalls: writing only $\cos(3x^{2}-1)$ and omitting 6x
using $-\sin u$ as the derivative of $\sin u$
differentiating the inner constant $-1$ as $-1$
solution.verification: At $x=0$ the inner rate is 0, and the formula gives $y'(0)=0$, as a composite rate should include the inner factor.
solution.takeaway: For the chain rule, differentiate the outer layer while keeping the inner expression, then multiply by the inner derivative.
solution.extension: For $y=\sin^{3}(3x^{2}-1)$, an additional outer power layer would also need the chain rule.

zh.title: 辨析四类求导公式
zh.prompt: 设各公式所需的可导、定义域、非零分母及反函数连续性条件均满足；对反函数公式，令 $y_{0}=f(x_{0})$ 且 $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$。下列公式中正确的是哪些？

solution.analysis: A、B、D 是标准公式；C 的错误在于外层导数应在内层函数值 $g(x)$ 处取值，而不是在 x 处取值。
steps: 乘积法则为 $(fg)'=f'g+fg'$，所以 A 正确。
在 $g\ne 0$ 处，商法则为 $(\frac{f}{g})'=\frac{f'g-fg'}{g^{2}}$，所以 B 正确。
链式法则的正确形式是 $(f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))g'(x)$，故 C 一般错误。
在题设反函数条件下，$(f^{-1})'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$，所以 D 正确。
pitfalls: 把乘积导数写成两个导数的乘积
商法则分子次序颠倒
链式法则中遗漏 $f'$ 的取值点 $g(x)$
solution.verification: 取 $f(u)=u^{2}$、$g(x)=x+1$，则复合导数为 $2(x+1)$，而 C 给出 2x，二者不同，直接否定 C。
solution.takeaway: 公式记忆应包含结构和取值点，尤其链式法则中的 $f'(g(x))$ 不能简写错位。
solution.extension: 把商 $\frac{f}{g}$ 写成 $f\cdot g^{-1}$，再用乘积与链式法则，也可推出商法则。

en.title: Distinguish Four Differentiation Formulas
en.prompt: Assume all differentiability, domain, nonzero-denominator, and inverse-continuity conditions required by the formulas hold. For the inverse formula, let $y_{0}=f(x_{0})$ and $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$. Which formulas are correct?

solution.analysis: A, B, and D are standard formulas. C is wrong because the derivative of the outer function must be evaluated at the inner value $g(x)$, not at x.
steps: The product rule is $(fg)'=f'g+fg'$, so A is correct.
Where $g\ne 0$, the quotient rule is $(\frac{f}{g})'=\frac{f'g-fg'}{g^{2}}$, so B is correct.
The correct chain rule is $(f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))g'(x)$, so C is generally false.
Under the stated inverse-function conditions, $(f^{-1})'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$, so D is correct.
pitfalls: writing the derivative of a product as the product of derivatives
reversing the numerator in the quotient rule
omitting the evaluation point $g(x)$ in the chain rule
solution.verification: Take $f(u)=u^{2}$ and $g(x)=x+1$. The composite derivative is $2(x+1)$, while C gives 2x, directly disproving C.
solution.takeaway: A formula includes both its algebraic structure and its evaluation points; $f'(g(x))$ in the chain rule is essential.
solution.extension: Writing $\frac{f}{g}$ as $f\cdot g^{-1}$ and applying the product and chain rules also derives the quotient rule.

zh.title: 有理函数的商法则
zh.prompt: 求 $y=\frac{x^{2}+1}{x-1}$ 的导数，并注明导数公式的适用范围。

solution.analysis: 把分子、分母分别看作 u、v，按“上导乘下减上乘下导，除以下平方”计算，并保留 $x\ne 1$。
steps: 所以 $y'=\frac{x^{2}-2x-1}{(x-1)^{2}}$；原函数与该求导式都只在 $x\ne 1$ 时讨论。
pitfalls: 把分母写成 $x-1$ 而不是 $(x-1)^{2}$
分子两项顺序颠倒导致整体符号相反
答案漏掉 $x\ne 1$
solution.takeaway: 商法则不仅要算对分子次序，还要保留原分母不为零的定义域条件。
solution.extension: 可比较先作代数除法再求导与直接使用商法则的工作量。

en.title: Quotient Rule for a Rational Function
en.prompt: Differentiate $y=\frac{x^{2}+1}{x-1}$, and state where the derivative formula applies.

solution.analysis: Treat the numerator and denominator as u and v. Use the quotient rule in its ordered form and retain the restriction $x\ne 1$.
steps: Let $u=x^{2}+1$ and $v=x-1$. Then $u'=2x$ and $v'=1$.
By the quotient rule, $y'=\frac{2x(x-1)-(x^{2}+1)\cdot 1}{(x-1)^{2}}$.
Simplify the numerator: $2x^{2}-2x-x^{2}-1=x^{2}-2x-1$.
Thus $y'=\frac{x^{2}-2x-1}{(x-1)^{2}}$; both the original function and this derivative are considered only for $x\ne 1$.
pitfalls: using $x-1$ instead of $(x-1)^{2}$ in the denominator
reversing the numerator terms and changing the overall sign
omitting $x\ne 1$
solution.verification: Polynomial division gives $y=x+1+\frac{2}{x-1}$, whose derivative is $1-\frac{2}{(x-1)^{2}}$; combining fractions reproduces $\frac{x^{2}-2x-1}{(x-1)^{2}}$.
solution.takeaway: For a quotient, preserve both the numerator order and the original nonzero-denominator condition.
solution.extension: Compare the work required by algebraic division followed by differentiation with direct use of the quotient rule.

zh.title: 振荡函数在原点的可导性
zh.prompt: 设 $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{x}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ 判断 $f$ 在 0 处是否可导，并求完整的导函数 $f'(x)$。
zh.answer: f 在 0 处可导，$f'(0)=0$；$x\ne 0$ 时 $f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$

solution.analysis: 原点不能直接套用 $x\ne 0$ 的公式，必须从定义出发；非零点再用乘积法则与链式法则。
steps: 原点差商为 $\frac{f(h)-f(0)}{h}=h \sin(\frac{1}{h})$，其中 $h\ne 0$。
因为 $|h \sin(\frac{1}{h})|\le |h|\to 0$，所以差商极限存在，$f'(0)=0$。
当 $x\ne 0$ 时，对 $x^{2}\sin(\frac{1}{x})$ 使用乘积法则：第一项为 $2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})$。
链式求第二项：$x^{2}\cdot \cos(\frac{1}{x})\cdot (-\frac{1}{x^{2}})=-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$，故 $f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$。
pitfalls: 把 $x\ne 0$ 的求导式直接代入 $x=0$
认为 $\sin(\frac{1}{h})$ 无极限就断言乘积无极限
链式求导遗漏 $-\frac{1}{x^{2}}$
solution.verification: 原点差商的绝对值被 $|h|$ 控制，严格趋于 0；非零点公式中两项分别对应乘积法则的两部分。
solution.takeaway: 特殊点先用定义；振荡因子即使无极限，乘上足够小的因子仍可能产生导数。
solution.extension: 继续考察 $x\to 0$ 时 $f'(x)$ 是否趋于 $f'(0)$，可以区分“可导”与“导函数连续”。

en.title: Differentiability of an Oscillatory Function at the Origin
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{x}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ Decide whether $f$ is differentiable at 0, and find the complete derivative $f'(x)$.
en.answer: f is differentiable at 0 with $f'(0)=0$; for $x\ne 0, f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$

knowledge: using the definition at a special point
solution.analysis: The formula for $x\ne 0$ cannot simply be used at the origin; first principles are required there. At nonzero points, use the product and chain rules.
steps: At the origin the difference quotient is $\frac{f(h)-f(0)}{h}=h \sin(\frac{1}{h})$ for $h\ne 0$.
Since $|h \sin(\frac{1}{h})|\le |h|\to 0$, the quotient has a limit and $f'(0)=0$.
For $x\ne 0$, applying the product rule to $x^{2}\sin(\frac{1}{x})$ gives the first term $2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})$.
The chain-rule contribution is $x^{2}\cdot \cos(\frac{1}{x})\cdot (-\frac{1}{x^{2}})=-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$, so $f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x})-\cos(\frac{1}{x})$.
pitfalls: substituting $x=0$ into the derivative formula for $x\ne 0$
declaring no limit merely because $\sin(\frac{1}{h})$ oscillates
omitting $-\frac{1}{x^{2}}$ in the chain rule
solution.verification: The absolute value of the origin quotient is bounded by $|h|$, which rigorously tends to 0; the two nonzero-point terms correspond exactly to the two product-rule contributions.
solution.takeaway: Use the definition at exceptional points; an oscillatory factor without a limit may still yield a derivative when multiplied by a sufficiently small factor.
solution.extension: Examining whether $f'(x)$ tends to $f'(0)$ as $x\to 0$ distinguishes differentiability from continuity of the derivative.

zh.title: 偶函数在原点可导时的斜率
zh.prompt: 设 f 是偶函数，且 f 在 $x=0$ 处可导。证明 $f'(0)=0$。

knowledge: 导数存在时左右极限相等
solution.analysis: 偶性使左侧函数增量与右侧函数增量相同，但分母符号相反，因此两个单侧导数互为相反数；可导又要求它们相等。
pitfalls: 只用偶性就断言导数一定存在
变量替换 $h=-t$ 后漏掉分母负号
没有使用可导带来的左右相等
solution.verification: 例如 $f(x)=x^{2}$、$\cos x$ 都是偶函数并在 0 可导，它们在 0 的导数确实为 0；而 $|x|$ 提醒我们可导假设不可省略。
solution.takeaway: 对称性控制单侧斜率的关系；偶函数的左右斜率互为相反数，可导时只能共同为 0。
solution.extension: 若 f 是奇函数且在 0 可导，$f'(0)$ 不必为 0，例如 $f(x)=x$。

en.title: Slope of an Even Function at the Origin
en.prompt: Suppose f is even and differentiable at $x=0$. Prove that $f'(0)=0$.
en.answer: Using $f(-h)=f(h)$ to compare the one-sided quotients gives $f'(0)=-f'(0)$, hence $f'(0)=0$.

knowledge: equality of one-sided limits when the derivative exists
solution.analysis: Evenness makes the left and right function increments equal, while their denominators have opposite signs. Thus the one-sided derivatives are opposites; differentiability also requires them to be equal.
steps: The right derivative is $f'_{+}(0)=\lim_{h\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(h)-f(0)}{h}$.
In the left derivative set $h=-t$ with $t\to 0^{+}: f'_{-}(0)=\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(-t)-f(0)}{-t}$.
Since f is differentiable at $0, f'_{-}(0)=f'_{+}(0)=f'(0)$. Therefore $f'(0)=-f'(0)$, and $f'(0)=0$.
pitfalls: claiming existence of the derivative from evenness alone
losing the minus sign after substituting $h=-t$
not using equality of the one-sided derivatives
solution.verification: The even functions $f(x)=x^{2}$ and $\cos x$ both have derivative 0 at the origin, while $|x|$ shows why the differentiability assumption cannot be removed.
solution.takeaway: Symmetry controls one-sided slopes: an even function has opposite one-sided slopes at 0, so differentiability forces both to be 0.
solution.extension: For an odd function differentiable at 0, the derivative need not be $0; f(x)=x$ is an example.

zh.title: 从平均速度到瞬时方向
zh.prompt: 质点的位置为 $s(t)=t^{3}-3t^{2}+2t$（m），t 以 s 为单位。(1) 求区间 $[1,1+h]$（$h\ne 0$）上的平均速度；(2) 由定义求 $v(1)$；(3) 写出位置—时间曲线在 $(1,s(1))$ 处的切线；(4) 解释 $v(1)$ 的符号。

solution.analysis: 四问共用同一个差商。先精确展开 $s(1+h)-s(1)$，再分别把差商解释为平均速度、极限和切线斜率。
steps: 令 $h\to 0$，得到瞬时速度 $v(1)=\lim_{h\to 0}(-1+h^{2})=-1\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$。
速度为负表示在 $t=1$ 的瞬间，位置沿预先规定的正坐标方向的反方向变化；它不表示距离为负。
pitfalls: 把 h 只允许取正值而忽略双侧瞬时速度
混淆坐标 s 与速率 $|v|$
切线中把横轴变量误写成 x 而不说明
solution.verification: 平均速度 $-1+h^{2}$ 在 $h\to 0^{+}$ 与 $h\to 0^{-}$ 时都趋于 $-1$，说明双侧瞬时速度一致；切线斜率也等于 $-1$。
solution.takeaway: 同一差商可同时连接代数极限、物理变化率和图像切线三种含义。
solution.extension: 比较 $h=0.1$ 与 $h=-0.1$ 的平均速度，二者均为 $-0.99\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$，体现其对瞬时速度的逼近。

en.title: From Average Velocity to Instantaneous Direction
en.prompt: A particle has position $s(t)=t^{3}-3t^{2}+2t$ meters, with t in seconds. (1) Find the average velocity on $[1,1+h]$ for $h\ne 0$. (2) Use the definition to find $v(1)$. (3) Write the tangent to the position-time curve at $(1,s(1))$. (4) Interpret the sign of $v(1)$.
en.answer: (1) $(-1+h^{2})\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$; (2) $v(1)=-1\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$; (3) $s=-(t-1)$; (4) the particle is moving in the negative direction at that instant

solution.analysis: All four parts use the same quotient. First expand $s(1+h)-s(1)$ exactly, then interpret the quotient as an average velocity, a limit, and a tangent slope.
steps: The average velocity on $[1,1+h]$ is $\frac{s(1+h)-s(1)}{h}=\frac{-h+h^{3}}{h}=(-1+h^{2})\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$.
Let $h\to 0$ to obtain the instantaneous velocity $v(1)=\lim_{h\to 0}(-1+h^{2})=-1\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$.
The point on the position-time graph is $(1,0)$ and the slope is $-1$, so its tangent is $s-0=-1(t-1)$, or $s=-(t-1)$.
The negative velocity means that at $t=1$ the position is changing opposite the chosen positive coordinate direction; it does not mean that distance is negative.
pitfalls: allowing only positive h and missing the two-sided instantaneous velocity
confusing position s with speed $|v|$
using x for the horizontal variable without explaining it
solution.verification: The average velocity $-1+h^{2}$ tends to $-1$ from both $h\to 0^{+}$ and $h\to 0^{-}$, so the two-sided instantaneous velocity agrees; the tangent slope is also $-1$.
solution.takeaway: One difference quotient connects an algebraic limit, a physical rate, and a graphical tangent slope.
solution.extension: For $h=0.1$ and $h=-0.1$, the average velocity is $-0.99\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ in both cases, illustrating approximation to the instantaneous value.

zh.title: “无穷大导数”的错误
zh.prompt: 函数 $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ 的定义域为 $[0,+\infty)$。某同学写道：“$f'(0)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{h}-0}{h}=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{1}{\sqrt{h}}=+\infty$，所以 $f'(0)=+\infty$。”指出这段推理中的所有关键错误，并给出正确结论。
zh.answer: h 只能从右侧趋于 0；右差商无界而不是趋于有限实数，因此通常意义下 $f'(0)$ 不存在，不能写成 $f'(0)=+\infty$。

knowledge: 定义域端点的单侧增量
竖直切线与有限导数的区别
solution.analysis: 错误有两层：允许的增量方向受定义域限制；即使右侧差商趋于 $+\infty$，它也不是有限导数值。
steps: 因为 f 只在 $x\ge 0$ 有定义，以 0 为基点时必须有 $h\ge 0$；差商只能考察 $h\to 0^{+}$，不能写无方向的 $h\to 0$。
对 $h>0$，差商 $\frac{\sqrt{h}-0}{h}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{h}}$，且当 $h\to 0^{+}$ 时它无界增大。
通常的导数定义要求差商收敛到一个有限实数；$+\infty$ 描述无界行为，不是一个可接受的导数值。
因此正确结论是：f 在端点 0 没有有限右导数，通常意义下 $f'(0)$ 不存在；图像可描述为在原点具有竖直切线趋势，但不能据此写 $f'(0)=+\infty$。
pitfalls: 在端点使用不存在于定义域内的负增量
把无穷符号当作普通实数
把“竖直切线”与“存在有限导数”混为一谈
solution.takeaway: 导数判断先检查允许的趋近方向，再检查差商是否趋于有限实数。
solution.extension: 对 $f(x)=x^{\frac{1}{3}}$ 在 0 的双侧差商也无界为正，同样没有有限导数。

en.title: The Error in an “Infinite Derivative”
en.prompt: The function $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ has domain $[0,+\infty)$. A student writes: “$f'(0)=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{h}-0}{h}=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{1}{\sqrt{h}}=+\infty$, so $f'(0)=+\infty$.” Identify every key error and give the correct conclusion.
en.answer: Only $h\to 0^{+}$ is allowed; the right-hand quotient is unbounded rather than convergent to a finite real number. Thus $f'(0)$ does not exist in the usual sense, and one must not write $f'(0)=+\infty$.

knowledge: one-sided increments at a domain endpoint
a derivative must be a finite real number
solution.analysis: There are two errors: the domain restricts the direction of the increment, and even the right-hand quotient tends to $+\infty$ rather than to a finite derivative value.
steps: Because f is defined only for $x\ge 0$, an increment from the base point 0 must satisfy $h\ge 0$; only $h\to 0^{+}$ is admissible, not an unrestricted $h\to 0$.
For $h>0$, the quotient is $\frac{\sqrt{h}-0}{h}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{h}}$, which grows without bound as $h\to 0^{+}$.
The usual derivative definition requires convergence of the quotient to a finite real number; $+\infty$ records unbounded behavior and is not an acceptable derivative value.

Therefore f has no finite right derivative at the endpoint 0, and $f'(0)$ does not exist in the usual sense. The graph may be described as having a vertical-tangent tendency at the origin, but this does not justify $f'(0)=+\infty$.
pitfalls: using negative increments that leave the domain
treating the infinity symbol as an ordinary real number
confusing a vertical tangent with existence of a finite derivative
solution.verification: For $h=10^{-2},10^{-4},10^{-6}$, the quotients are 10,100,1000, showing unbounded growth rather than convergence to a finite number.
solution.takeaway: When testing a derivative, first check the permitted direction of approach and then require a finite quotient limit.
solution.extension: For $f(x)=x^{\frac{1}{3}}$, the two-sided quotient at 0 is also unbounded and positive, so there is again no finite derivative.

zh.title: 识别不对称割线的极限
zh.prompt: 已知 f 在 $x_{0}$ 处可导。下列极限中，哪一个必等于 $f'(x_{0})$？

solution.analysis: 在不对称的两个函数值之间加减 $f(x_{0})$，把一个差商拆成两个标准导数差商，并跟踪各自的系数。
steps: 除以 3h 后，第一项可写成 $\frac{(\frac{2}{3})\cdot [f(x_{0}+2h)-f(x_{0})]}{2h}$，其极限为 $(\frac{2}{3})f'(x_{0})$。
两项相加为 $f'(x_{0})$，故 A 正确；同理 B、C、D 的极限系数分别为 $\frac{3}{2}$、2、2，一般不等于 $f'(x_{0})$。
pitfalls: 看到 $h\to 0$ 就忽略分母系数
第二项改写时丢失两个负号
把 $x_{0}+2h$ 的增量误认为 h
solution.takeaway: 变形差商的关键是以 $f(x_{0})$ 为中介拆分，并让每个分母与其真实增量匹配。

en.title: Recognizing the Limit of an Asymmetric Secant
en.prompt: Suppose f is differentiable at $x_{0}$. Which limit must equal $f'(x_{0})$?

knowledge: adding and subtracting a common base value
solution.analysis: Insert and subtract $f(x_{0})$ between the two asymmetric function values. This splits the expression into standard derivative quotients whose coefficients must be tracked.
steps: After division by 3h, the first term is $\frac{(\frac{2}{3})\cdot [f(x_{0}+2h)-f(x_{0})]}{2h}$, whose limit is $(\frac{2}{3})f'(x_{0})$.
The second term is $\frac{(\frac{1}{3})\cdot [f(x_{0})-f(x_{0}-h)]}{h}=\frac{(\frac{1}{3})\cdot [f(x_{0}-h)-f(x_{0})]}{-h}$, whose limit is $(\frac{1}{3})f'(x_{0})$.
Their sum is $f'(x_{0})$, so A is correct. The corresponding coefficients for B, C, and D are $\frac{3}{2}, 2$, and 2, respectively.
pitfalls: ignoring denominator coefficients merely because $h\to 0$
losing the two minus signs in the second term
treating 2h as though the increment were h
solution.verification: For $f(x)=x$, the four limits are $1,\frac{3}{2},2,2$, while $f'(x_{0})=1$; only A works.
solution.takeaway: For a modified quotient, split at $f(x_{0})$ and match every denominator to its actual input increment.
solution.extension: For $a,b>0,\frac{f(x_{0}+ah)-f(x_{0}-bh)}{(a+b)h}$ also tends to $f'(x_{0})$.

zh.title: 移动尖点与参数分类
zh.prompt: 设 $f_{a,b}(x)=|x-a|+bx$，其中 $a,b\in \mathbb{R}$。确定所有使 $f_{a,b}$ 在 $x=0$ 处可导的参数对 (a,b)，并求相应的 $f'_{a,b}(0)$。
zh.answer: 当且仅当 $a\ne 0$ 时可导；此时 $f'_{a,b}(0)=b-\operatorname{sgn}(a)$，其中 $\operatorname{sgn}(a)=1$（$a>0$），$\operatorname{sgn}(a)=-1$（$a<0$）

solution.analysis: 关键不是 b，而是绝对值尖点 $x=a$ 是否恰好落在考察点 0。$a\ne 0$ 时，0 的小邻域只落在绝对值的一侧；$a=0$ 时线性项无法消除左右斜率之差 2。
steps: 上述两种情形都可写成 $f'_{a,b}(0)=b-\operatorname{sgn}(a)$，且任意 b 均允许。
若 $a=0$，则差商为 $\frac{|h|+bh}{h}$；左极限为 $b-1$，右极限为 $b+1$，二者相差 2，不可能相等。
因此可导的充要条件是 $a\ne 0$，b 不受限制；导数如上。
pitfalls: 认为选择某个 b 可以抹平 $|x|$ 的尖角
$a<0$ 时把 $|x-a|$ 的局部形式写反
只给充分条件而未排除 $a=0$
solution.verification: 取 $a=2$ 时导数为 $b-1$；取 $a=-2$ 时导数为 $b+1$；当 $a=0$ 时无论 b 取何值，左右导数之差恒为 2。
solution.takeaway: 绝对值函数是否影响某点可导，取决于尖点是否位于该点；普通线性项只会同时平移两侧斜率。
solution.extension: 把考察点改为 $x=c$，则可导的充要条件变为 $a\ne c$。

en.title: A Moving Corner and Parameter Classification
en.prompt: Let $f_{a,b}(x)=|x-a|+bx$, where $a,b\in \mathbb{R}$. Determine all pairs (a,b) for which $f_{a,b}$ is differentiable at $x=0$, and find $f'_{a,b}(0)$.
en.answer: Differentiable exactly when $a\ne 0$; then $f'_{a,b}(0)=b-\operatorname{sgn}(a)$, where $\operatorname{sgn}(a)=1$ for $a>0$ and $\operatorname{sgn}(a)=-1$ for $a<0$

solution.analysis: The decisive issue is not b but whether the corner $x=a$ coincides with the test point 0. If $a\ne 0, a$ small neighborhood of 0 stays on one side of the corner. If $a=0, a$ linear term cannot remove the slope jump of 2.
steps: If $a>0$, choose a sufficiently small neighborhood of 0 where $x-a<0$. Then $|x-a|=a-x$, so $f_{a,b}(x)=a+(b-1)x$ and $f'_{a,b}(0)=b-1$.
If $a<0$, choose a sufficiently small neighborhood where $x-a>0$. Then $|x-a|=x-a$, so $f_{a,b}(x)=-a+(b+1)x$ and $f'_{a,b}(0)=b+1$.
Both cases can be written as $f'_{a,b}(0)=b-\operatorname{sgn}(a)$, and every b is allowed.
If $a=0$, the quotient is $\frac{|h|+bh}{h}$. Its left limit is $b-1$ and its right limit is $b+1$, which always differ by 2.
Therefore $a\ne 0$ is necessary and sufficient, with b unrestricted and the derivative as stated.
pitfalls: thinking that a suitable b can smooth the corner of $|x|$
using the wrong local expression for $|x-a|$ when $a<0$
giving only a sufficient condition without excluding $a=0$
solution.verification: For $a=2$ the derivative is $b-1$; for $a=-2$ it is $b+1$. When $a=0$, the one-sided derivatives differ by 2 for every b.
solution.takeaway: An absolute value affects differentiability at a point only when its corner lies there; adding a linear term shifts both one-sided slopes equally.
solution.extension: If the test point is changed to $x=c$, differentiability holds exactly when $a\ne c$.

zh.title: 在对应点求反函数导数

solution.analysis: 先寻找满足 $f(x_{0})=2$ 的原函数点 $x_{0}$，再在该点求 $f'$，最后取倒数。
pitfalls: 直接把 $y=2$ 代入 $f'(x)$
把反函数 $f^{-1}$ 误解为倒数 $\frac{1}{f}$
忘记先确认对应的 $x_{0}$
solution.verification: 局部增量满足 $\Delta y\approx 4\Delta x$，因此反向看 $\Delta x\approx (\frac{1}{4})\Delta y$，与 $g'(2)=\frac{1}{4}$ 一致。
solution.takeaway: 反函数导数要在一对对应点上取倒数：先由 $y_{0}$ 找 $x_{0}=g(y_{0})$，再计算 $\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$。

en.title: Derivative of an Inverse at a Corresponding Point
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=x^{3}+x$ and $g=f^{-1}$. Given that g is differentiable at $y=2$, find $g'(2)$.

solution.analysis: First find $x_{0}$ satisfying $f(x_{0})=2$, then evaluate $f'$ at that point and take the reciprocal.
steps: The derivative of the original function is $f'(x)=3x^{2}+1$.
At the corresponding point $x_{0}=1, f'(1)=3+1=4\ne 0$.
The inverse-function formula gives $g'(2)=\frac{1}{f'(g(2))}=\frac{1}{f'(1)}=\frac{1}{4}$.
pitfalls: substituting $y=2$ directly into $f'(x)$
confusing the inverse function $f^{-1}$ with the reciprocal $\frac{1}{f}$
failing to find the corresponding $x_{0}$ first
solution.verification: Locally $\Delta y\approx 4\Delta x$, so in the reverse direction $\Delta x\approx (\frac{1}{4})\Delta y$, consistent with $g'(2)=\frac{1}{4}$.
solution.takeaway: An inverse derivative is a reciprocal at corresponding points: find $x_{0}=g(y_{0})$, then compute $\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$.
solution.extension: For $g'(0)$, the corresponding point is $x_{0}=0$, giving $g'(0)=1$.

en: adding and subtracting an intermediate term

zh.title: 从定义证明乘积法则

solution.analysis: 在乘积增量中加减 $u(x_{0}+h)v(x_{0})$，使其分裂成一个 u 的差商和一个 v 的差商。可导还保证 $u(x_{0}+h)\to u(x_{0})$。
steps: 分别取极限并相加，得到 $(uv)'(x_{0})=u(x_{0})v'(x_{0})+v(x_{0})u'(x_{0})$，与待证公式相同。
pitfalls: 直接把乘积差写成两个差的乘积
加减中间项后因子配错
使用 $u(x_{0}+h)\to u(x_{0})$ 却不说明可导蕴含连续
solution.takeaway: 证明运算法则的常用技巧是加入合适的中间项，把复杂增量拆成已知差商。
solution.extension: 采用类似分解并处理分母变化，可从定义证明商法则。

en.title: Prove the Product Rule from First Principles
en.prompt: Suppose u and v are differentiable at $x_{0}$. Using only the definition of the derivative, prove $(uv)'(x_{0})=u'(x_{0})v(x_{0})+u(x_{0})v'(x_{0})$.

knowledge: sum and product laws for limits
solution.analysis: Add and subtract $u(x_{0}+h)v(x_{0})$ in the product increment. This produces one difference quotient for u and one for v. Differentiability also gives $u(x_{0}+h)\to u(x_{0})$.
steps: By definition, $(uv)'(x_{0})=\lim_{h\to 0}\frac{u(x_{0}+h)v(x_{0}+h)-u(x_{0})v(x_{0})}{h}$.
Add and subtract $u(x_{0}+h)v(x_{0})$ in the numerator to obtain $u(x_{0}+h)[v(x_{0}+h)-v(x_{0})]+v(x_{0})[u(x_{0}+h)-u(x_{0})]$.
After division by h, the quotient is $\frac{u(x_{0}+h)\cdot [v(x_{0}+h)-v(x_{0})]}{h}+\frac{v(x_{0})\cdot [u(x_{0}+h)-u(x_{0})]}{h}$.
Since u is differentiable at $x_{0}$, it is continuous there, so $u(x_{0}+h)\to u(x_{0})$. The two difference quotients tend to $v'(x_{0})$ and $u'(x_{0})$.
Taking limits term by term gives $(uv)'(x_{0})=u(x_{0})v'(x_{0})+v(x_{0})u'(x_{0})$, which is the desired formula.
pitfalls: splitting a difference of products into a product of differences
mismatching factors after adding the intermediate term
using $u(x_{0}+h)\to u(x_{0})$ without invoking differentiability-implies-continuity
solution.verification: For $u(x)=x^{2}$ and $v(x)=x^{3}$, the formula gives $2x\cdot x^{3}+x^{2}\cdot 3x^{2}=5x^{4}$, agreeing with $(x^{5})'=5x^{4}$.
solution.takeaway: A standard way to prove an operation rule is to insert a suitable intermediate term and split a complicated increment into known difference quotients.
solution.extension: A related decomposition, together with control of the changing denominator, proves the quotient rule from first principles.

zh.title: 多层复合与商的综合求导
zh.prompt: 求 $y=\frac{e^{\sin(x^{2})}}{1+x^{3}}$ 的导数，并注明定义域。

solution.analysis: 分子含 $e^{\sin(x^{2})}$ 的两层复合，分母是多项式。先分别求分子、分母的导数，再使用商法则。
steps: 对 u 逐层求导：$u'=e^{\sin(x^{2})}\cdot [\sin(x^{2})]'=e^{\sin(x^{2})}\cdot 2x \cos(x^{2})$。
分母导数为 $v'=3x^{2}$。
商法则给出 $y'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}$。
pitfalls: 求 $e^{\sin(x^{2})}$ 的导数时漏掉 $\cos(x^{2})$ 或 2x
商法则分子次序写反
忘记排除 $x=-1$
solution.verification: 在 $x=0$ 时公式给出 $y'(0)=0$；直接观察分子内层 $x^{2}$ 在 0 的导数为 0、分母导数也为 0，与结果一致。
solution.takeaway: 复杂表达式先画清层次：内部链式求导完成后，再进入外部的乘积或商法则。
solution.extension: 也可把函数写成 $e^{\sin(x^{2})}(1+x^{3})^{-1}$，用乘积与链式法则得到同一结果。

en.title: Combined Multilayer Chain and Quotient Rules
en.prompt: Differentiate $y=\frac{e^{\sin(x^{2})}}{1+x^{3}}$, and state its domain.

solution.analysis: The numerator $e^{\sin(x^{2})}$ has two nested layers, and the denominator is a polynomial. Differentiate them separately, then apply the quotient rule.
steps: Let $u(x)=e^{\sin(x^{2})}$ and $v(x)=1+x^{3}$, so $y=\frac{u}{v}$ and the domain requires $x\ne -1$.
Differentiate u layer by layer: $u'=e^{\sin(x^{2})}\cdot [\sin(x^{2})]'=e^{\sin(x^{2})}\cdot 2x \cos(x^{2})$.
The denominator derivative is $v'=3x^{2}$.
The quotient rule gives $y'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}$.
Substitute and factor to obtain $y'=\frac{e^{\sin(x^{2})}[2x \cos(x^{2})(1+x^{3})-3x^{2}]}{(1+x^{3})^{2}}$ for $x\ne -1$.
pitfalls: omitting $\cos(x^{2})$ or 2x when differentiating $e^{\sin(x^{2})}$
reversing the quotient-rule numerator
forgetting to exclude $x=-1$
solution.verification: At $x=0$ the formula gives $y'(0)=0$. The inner function $x^{2}$ and the denominator both have derivative 0 there, which agrees with the result.
solution.takeaway: Map the layers first: finish all inner chain rules before applying an outer product or quotient rule.
solution.extension: Writing the function as $e^{\sin(x^{2})}(1+x^{3})^{-1}$ and using the product and chain rules gives the same derivative.

zh.title: 参数幂尖点的完整判定
zh.prompt: 判断正误并证明：对 $\alpha >0$，函数 $f_\alpha (x)=|x|^\alpha$ 在 $x=0$ 处可导，当且仅当 $\alpha >1$；可导时 $f'_\alpha (0)=0$。

solution.analysis: 原点差商恰好是 $\frac{|h|^\alpha}{h}$。按 $\alpha -1$ 的正、零、负三种情形讨论，就能同时证明充分性和必要性。
steps: 由 $f_\alpha (0)=0$，原点差商为 $\frac{|h|^\alpha}{h}=\operatorname{sgn}(h)|h|^{\alpha -1}$。
若 $\alpha>1$，则 $\left|\operatorname{sgn}(h)\,|h|^{\alpha-1}\right|=|h|^{\alpha-1}\to 0$，所以双侧极限存在且 $f'_{\alpha}(0)=0$。
若 $\alpha =1$，则 $h\to 0^{+}$ 时差商为 1，$h\to 0^{-}$ 时为 $-1$，左右极限不等。
若 $0<\alpha <1$，则 $h\to 0^{+}$ 时差商 $h^{\alpha -1}$ 无界增大，而 $h\to 0^{-}$ 时为 $-|h|^{\alpha -1}$，不存在有限双侧极限。
三种情形穷尽 $\alpha >0$，因此可导当且仅当 $\alpha >1$，且导数必为 0。
pitfalls: 只证明 $\alpha >1$ 时可导而未证明其他参数不行
在 $\alpha =1$ 时把左右符号忽略
把无界差商误当成有限导数
solution.verification: $\alpha =2$ 给出 $x^{2}$，在 0 导数为 0；$\alpha =1$ 给出 $|x|$ 的尖角；$\alpha =\frac{1}{2}$ 给出更陡的根式尖点，均与分类一致。
solution.takeaway: 参数型可导问题常由差商中的临界指数决定；这里临界值正是 $\alpha =1$。
solution.extension: 若改为 $c|x|^\alpha$（$c\ne 0$），可导的参数范围不变，只是非零点导数按 c 缩放。

en.title: Complete Classification of a Parameterized Power Corner
en.prompt: Decide whether the following statement is true and prove it: for $\alpha>0$, $f_{\alpha}(x)=|x|^{\alpha}$ is differentiable at $x=0$ if and only if $\alpha>1$; when differentiable, $f'_{\alpha}(0)=0$.

solution.analysis: The origin quotient is exactly $\frac{|h|^\alpha}{h}$. Splitting according to whether $\alpha -1$ is positive, zero, or negative proves both sufficiency and necessity.
steps: Since $f_\alpha (0)=0$, the origin quotient is $\frac{|h|^\alpha}{h}=\operatorname{sgn}(h)|h|^{\alpha -1}$.
If $\alpha >1$, its absolute value is $|h|^{\alpha -1}\to 0$, so the two-sided limit exists and $f'_\alpha (0)=0$.
If $\alpha =1$, the quotient is 1 for $h\to 0^{+}$ and $-1$ for $h\to 0^{-}$, so the one-sided limits differ.
If $0<\alpha <1$, the quotient $h^{\alpha -1}$ grows without bound for $h\to 0^{+}$ and equals $-|h|^{\alpha -1}$ for $h\to 0^{-}$, so no finite two-sided limit exists.
These cases exhaust $\alpha >0$, proving differentiability exactly for $\alpha >1$, with derivative 0.
pitfalls: proving only sufficiency for $\alpha >1$
ignoring the opposite signs when $\alpha =1$
treating an unbounded quotient as a finite derivative
solution.verification: For $\alpha =2$ the function is $x^{2}$ and has derivative 0 at $0; \alpha =1$ gives the corner $|x|; \alpha =\frac{1}{2}$ gives an even steeper radical corner, matching the classification.
solution.takeaway: In a parameterized differentiability problem, a critical exponent in the difference quotient often controls the answer; here it is $\alpha =1$.
solution.extension: For $c|x|^\alpha$ with $c\ne 0$, the differentiability range is unchanged; derivatives away from the corner are simply scaled by c.

zh.title: 割线趋稳而邻近切线失控
zh.prompt: 设 $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ (1) 证明 $f$ 在 0 连续；(2) 证明 $f$ 在 0 可导并写出原点切线；(3) 求 $x\ne 0$ 时的 $f'(x)$；(4) 构造 $x_n\to 0^{+}$，说明 $f'(x)$ 在 0 不连续。

solution.analysis: 函数值与原点差商分别由 $x^{2}$、$|x|$ 控制，因此连续且可导；但非零点导数含 $\frac{1}{x}$ 放大项，可沿特定数列显示其无界。
steps: 原点差商为 $\frac{f(h)}{h}=h \sin(\frac{1}{h^{2}})$，绝对值不超过 $|h|$，所以 $f'(0)=0$；切点为 $(0,0)$，切线为 $y=0$。
于是 $f'(x_n)=-\frac{2}{x_n}\to -\infty$，不可能趋于 $f'(0)=0$；所以导函数在 0 不连续，尽管原点切线确实存在。
pitfalls: 从 $\sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$ 振荡直接误判 f 不连续
用 $x\ne 0$ 的导数公式代入 0
只说 $f'$ 振荡而不给能验证的数列
solution.verification: 割线斜率 $\frac{f(x)}{x}=x \sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$ 被 $|x|$ 控制而趋于 0；所构造数列上的邻近切线斜率却趋于 $-\infty$，两种结论并不矛盾。
solution.takeaway: 某点可导只控制通向该点的割线斜率，不保证附近各点的导数趋于该点导数。
solution.extension: 比较 $x^{2}\sin(\frac{1}{x})$ 与本题函数，观察振荡频率改变后非零点导数中放大因子的差异。

en.title: Stable Secants but Uncontrolled Nearby Tangents
en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ (1) Prove continuity at 0. (2) Prove differentiability at 0 and write the tangent there. (3) Find $f'(x)$ for $x\ne 0$. (4) Construct $x_n\to 0^{+}$ showing that $f'$ is not continuous at 0.
en.answer: f is continuous at 0 with $f'(0)=0$ and tangent $y=0$; for $x\ne 0, f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})-(\frac{2}{x})\cos(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$; one may take $x_n=(\frac{1}{2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{2}}$

knowledge: disproving a limit by a sequence
solution.analysis: The function value and the origin quotient are controlled by $x^{2}$ and $|x|$, so continuity and differentiability hold. However, the nonzero-point derivative contains a $\frac{1}{x}$ amplification, which becomes unbounded along a selected sequence.
steps: Since $|f(x)|=|x^{2}\sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})|\le x^{2}\to 0=f(0), f$ is continuous at 0.
The origin quotient is $\frac{f(h)}{h}=h \sin(\frac{1}{h^{2}})$, whose absolute value is at most $|h|$. Thus $f'(0)=0$, and the tangent through $(0,0)$ is $y=0$.
For $x\ne 0$, the product and chain rules give $f'(x)=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})+x^{2}\cos(\frac{1}{x^{2}})(-\frac{2}{x^{3}})=2x \sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})-(\frac{2}{x})\cos(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$.
Take $x_n=(\frac{1}{2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{2}}$. Then $x_n\to 0^{+},\frac{1}{x_n^{2}}=2\pi n, \sin(2\pi n)=0$, and $\cos(2\pi n)=1$.
Hence $f'(x_n)=-\frac{2}{x_n}\to -\infty$, so it cannot tend to $f'(0)=0$. Therefore $f'$ is not continuous at 0 even though the tangent there exists.
pitfalls: declaring f discontinuous merely because $\sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$ oscillates
substituting 0 into the derivative formula valid only for $x\ne 0$
claiming oscillation without supplying a verifiable sequence
solution.verification: The secant slope $\frac{f(x)}{x}=x \sin(\frac{1}{x^{2}})$ is bounded by $|x|$ and tends to 0, while the nearby tangent slopes along the constructed sequence tend to $-\infty$; these facts are compatible.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability at one point controls secants ending at that point, not convergence of derivatives at nearby points.
solution.extension: Compare $x^{2}\sin(\frac{1}{x})$ with the present function and observe how changing the oscillation rate changes the amplification term in the nonzero-point derivative.

zh.title: 多法则嵌套后的结构化简
zh.prompt: 求 $y=\arctan[\frac{e^{x}-1}{e^{x}+1}]$ 的导数，并将结果化为不含复合分式的形式。

solution.analysis: 先令 $u=\frac{e^{x}-1}{e^{x}+1}$，使用 $y'=\frac{u'}{1+u^{2}}$。$u'$ 与 $1+u^{2}$ 具有相同的分母，约去后结果会显著简化。
steps: 由于 $e^{x}+1>0$ 且 $e^{2x}+1>0$，原函数与导数对所有 $x\in \mathbb{R}$ 都有定义。
pitfalls: 把 $(\arctan u)'$ 写成 $\frac{1}{1+u}$
商法则中漏掉两个 $e^{x}$ 项
未先通分 $1+u^{2}$ 就进行错误约分
solution.takeaway: 嵌套求导后不要急于展开；寻找 $u'$ 与 $1+u^{2}$ 的公共结构可大幅简化。
solution.extension: 把 $e^{x}$ 换成任意正函数 $w(x)$，可按同一结构求 $\arctan[\frac{w-1}{w+1}]$ 的导数。

en.title: Structural Simplification after Nested Rules
en.prompt: Differentiate $y=\arctan[\frac{e^{x}-1}{e^{x}+1}]$, and simplify the result so that it contains no compound fraction.

solution.analysis: Set $u=\frac{e^{x}-1}{e^{x}+1}$ and use $y'=\frac{u'}{1+u^{2}}$. The expressions $u'$ and $1+u^{2}$ share the same denominator, which cancels cleanly.
steps: Let $u=\frac{e^{x}-1}{e^{x}+1}$, so $y=\arctan u$ and $y'=\frac{u'}{1+u^{2}}$.
Because $e^{x}+1>0$ and $e^{2x}+1>0$, both the function and its derivative are defined for every $x\in \mathbb{R}$.
pitfalls: using $\frac{1}{1+u}$ as the derivative of $\arctan u$
losing exponential terms in the quotient rule
canceling incorrectly before placing $1+u^{2}$ over a common denominator
solution.verification: At $x=0, u=0$ and $u'=\frac{1}{2}$, so $y'(0)=\frac{1}{2}$. The simplified formula also gives $\frac{1}{1+1}=\frac{1}{2}$.
solution.takeaway: After nested differentiation, look for shared structure before expanding; here the denominators of $u'$ and $1+u^{2}$ cancel completely.
solution.extension: Replace $e^{x}$ by any positive differentiable function $w(x)$ and apply the same structure to $\arctan[\frac{w-1}{w+1}]$.

zh.title: 从定义证明反函数求导公式
zh.prompt: 设 f 在 $x_{0}$ 的某邻域 U 上一一对应，其值域包含 $y_{0}=f(x_{0})$ 的一个邻域，并在该值域上有反函数 $x=g(y)$。已知 f 在 $x_{0}$ 可导、$f'(x_{0})\ne 0$，并且 $y\to y_{0}$ 时 $g(y)\to x_{0}$。证明 $g'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$。

solution.analysis: 反函数的 y 增量与原函数的 x 增量描述同一对点。把 g 的差商写成 f 的差商的倒数，并利用 $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$。
steps: 令 $\Delta y=y-y_{0}$，且 $\Delta x=g(y)-g(y_{0})=g(y)-x_{0}$；因 g 是反函数，有 $\Delta y=f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})$。
当 $y\to y_{0}$ 时，由题设 $\Delta x\to 0$；并且在 $y\ne y_{0}$ 时，反函数的单值性保证 $\Delta x\ne 0$。
反函数差商可写为 $\frac{g(y)-g(y_{0})}{y-y_{0}}=\frac{\Delta x}{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}$。
将其写成倒数：$\frac{\Delta x}{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}={\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}}^{-1}$。
括号内当 $\Delta x\to 0$ 时趋于 $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$，所以倒数极限存在并等于 $\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$，即 $g'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$。
pitfalls: 把反函数与倒数函数混淆
未说明 $\Delta y\to 0$ 会使对应 $\Delta x\to 0$
在 $f'(x_{0})=0$ 时仍擅自取倒数
solution.verification: 若 $f(x)=3x+2$，则 $g(y)=\frac{y-2}{3}$；公式给出 $g'=\frac{1}{3}$，与直接求导一致。
solution.takeaway: 反函数求导公式本质上是同一局部变化率从“$\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$”切换到“$\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta y}$”。
solution.extension: 在具体题中应先定位对应点 $x_{0}=g(y_{0})$，再使用该公式，而不是把 $y_{0}$ 直接代入 $f'$。

en.title: Prove the Inverse-Function Derivative Formula from First Principles
en.prompt: Suppose f is one-to-one on a neighborhood U of $x_{0}$, its image contains a neighborhood of $y_{0}=f(x_{0})$, and it has inverse $x=g(y)$ on that image. Assume f is differentiable at $x_{0}, f'(x_{0})\ne 0$, and $g(y)\to x_{0}$ as $y\to y_{0}$. Prove $g'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$.

knowledge: reciprocal law for a nonzero limit
solution.analysis: The $y$-increment for the inverse and the $x$-increment for the original function describe the same pair of points. Rewrite the quotient for g as the reciprocal of the quotient for f and use $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$.
steps: Let $\Delta y=y-y_{0}$ and $\Delta x=g(y)-g(y_{0})=g(y)-x_{0}$. Since g is the inverse, $\Delta y=f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})$.
As $y\to y_{0}$, the assumption gives $\Delta x\to 0$. For $y\ne y_{0}$, the single-valued inverse relation also gives $\Delta x\ne 0$.
The inverse difference quotient is $\frac{g(y)-g(y_{0})}{y-y_{0}}=\frac{\Delta x}{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}$.
Rewrite it as a reciprocal: $\frac{\Delta x}{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}={\frac{f(x_{0}+\Delta x)-f(x_{0})}{\Delta x}}^{-1}$.
The expression in braces tends to $f'(x_{0})\ne 0$ as $\Delta x\to 0$, so the reciprocal tends to $\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$. Hence $g'(y_{0})=\frac{1}{f'(x_{0})}$.
pitfalls: confusing an inverse function with a reciprocal function
not explaining why $\Delta y\to 0$ makes the corresponding $\Delta x\to 0$
taking a reciprocal even when $f'(x_{0})=0$
solution.verification: For $f(x)=3x+2$, the inverse is $g(y)=\frac{y-2}{3}$. The formula gives $g'=\frac{1}{3}$, agreeing with direct differentiation.
solution.takeaway: The inverse derivative formula switches the same local rate from $\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$ to its reciprocal $\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta y}$.
solution.extension: In an application, first locate $x_{0}=g(y_{0})$; do not substitute $y_{0}$ directly into $f'$.

zh.title: 双参数振荡族的临界指数
zh.prompt: 设 $\alpha,\beta>0$，且 $f_{\alpha,\beta}(x)=\begin{cases}|x|^{\alpha}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{|x|^{\beta}}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ (1) 证明 $f_{\alpha,\beta}$ 在 0 连续；(2) 完整判定它在 0 可导的充要条件；(3) 在可导情形下，完整判定 $f'_{\alpha,\beta}$ 在 0 连续的充要条件。
zh.answer: (1) 对所有 $\alpha,\beta>0$ 均连续；(2) 在 0 可导当且仅当 $\alpha>1$，且 $f'(0)=0$；(3) $f'$ 在 0 连续当且仅当 $\alpha>\beta+1$。

solution.analysis: 连续性由 $|x|^\alpha$ 控制；可导性由差商中的指数 $\alpha -1$ 控制；导函数连续性还会受到相位求导产生的 $|x|^{-\beta -1}$ 放大，因此临界指数提高到 $\beta +1$。
steps: 由 $|f_{\alpha,\beta}(x)|\le |x|^\alpha$ 且 $\alpha >0$，$x\to 0$ 时右端趋于 $0=f_{\alpha,\beta}(0)$，所以对所有 $\alpha,\beta >0$，函数都在 0 连续。
原点差商为 $\operatorname{sgn}(h)|h|^{\alpha -1}\sin(\frac{1}{|h|^\beta})$。若 $\alpha >1$，其绝对值不超过 $|h|^{\alpha -1}\to 0$，故 $f'(0)=0$。
若 $\alpha =1$，取正数列 $h_n=(\frac{1}{\frac{\pi}{2}+2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}$，差商恒为 1；再取 $k_n=(\frac{1}{\frac{3\pi}{2}+2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}$，差商恒为 $-1$，故导数不存在。
若 $0<\alpha <1$，沿同一 $h_n$ 有差商 $h_n^{\alpha -1}\to +\infty$，没有有限导数。因此在 0 可导当且仅当 $\alpha >1$。
对 $x\ne 0$ 求导得 $f'(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(x)[\alpha |x|^{\alpha -1}\sin(\frac{1}{|x|^\beta})-\beta |x|^{\alpha -\beta -1}\cos(\frac{1}{|x|^\beta})]$。
若 $\alpha >\beta +1$，则 $\alpha -1>0$ 且 $\alpha -\beta -1>0$，两个括号项的绝对值分别被 $\alpha |x|^{\alpha -1}$、$\beta |x|^{\alpha -\beta -1}$ 控制并趋于 0，所以 $f'(x)\to 0=f'(0)$。
若 $1<\alpha \le \beta +1$，取 $x_n=(\frac{1}{2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}>0$，则正弦项为 0、余弦项为 1，故 $f'(x_n)=-\beta x_n^{\alpha -\beta -1}$；指数为 0 时恒为 $-\beta$，指数为负时绝对值无界，都不趋于 0。
因此在可导范围内，$f'$ 在 0 连续当且仅当 $\alpha >\beta +1$。
pitfalls: 只看函数中的 $|x|^\alpha$ 而忽略差商会降低一次幂
求相位 $\frac{1}{|x|^\beta}$ 的导数时漏掉 $\operatorname{sgn}(x)$ 或指数 $\beta +1$
必要性只说“振荡”却不给数列
把 $\alpha >1$ 与 $\alpha >\beta +1$ 混为一个条件
solution.verification: 取 $(\alpha,\beta)=(2,1)$，函数在 0 可导但 $\alpha =\beta +1$，导函数不连续；取 $(3,1)$，有 $\alpha >\beta +1$，导函数连续，说明两个临界条件确实不同。
solution.takeaway: 每进行一次差商或相位求导，都要重新计算控制振荡的净幂次；临界指数由最强放大项决定。
solution.extension: 将 sin 换成 cos 并适当重新定义 $f(0)$，可设计相似的连续、可导与导函数连续分类问题。

en.title: Critical Exponents in a Two-Parameter Oscillatory Family
en.prompt: Let $\alpha,\beta>0$ and $f_{\alpha,\beta}(x)=\begin{cases}|x|^{\alpha}\sin\!\left(\frac{1}{|x|^{\beta}}\right),&x\ne 0,\\0,&x=0.\end{cases}$ (1) Prove that $f_{\alpha,\beta}$ is continuous at 0. (2) Completely classify differentiability at 0. (3) When it is differentiable, completely classify continuity of $f'_{\alpha,\beta}$ at 0.
en.answer: (1) Continuous for all $\alpha,\beta>0$; (2) differentiable at 0 exactly when $\alpha>1$, with $f'(0)=0$; (3) $f'$ is continuous at 0 exactly when $\alpha>\beta+1$.

solution.analysis: Continuity is controlled by $|x|^\alpha$. Differentiability is controlled by $\alpha -1$ in the quotient. Differentiating the phase introduces the amplification $|x|^{-\beta -1}$, raising the critical exponent for continuity of the derivative to $\beta +1$.
steps: Since $|f_{\alpha,\beta}(x)|\le |x|^\alpha$ and $\alpha >0$, the right-hand side tends to $0=f_{\alpha,\beta}(0)$ as $x\to 0$. Thus the function is continuous at 0 for all $\alpha,\beta >0$.
The origin quotient is $\operatorname{sgn}(h)|h|^{\alpha -1}\sin(\frac{1}{|h|^\beta})$. If $\alpha >1$, its absolute value is at most $|h|^{\alpha -1}\to 0$, so $f'(0)=0$.

If $\alpha =1$, take positive $h_n=(\frac{1}{\frac{\pi}{2}+2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}$, for which the quotient is 1, and $k_n=(\frac{1}{\frac{3\pi}{2}+2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}$, for which it is $-1$. Thus no derivative exists.
If $0<\alpha <1$, along the same $h_n$ the quotient is $h_n^{\alpha -1}\to +\infty$, so there is no finite derivative. Hence differentiability at 0 holds exactly when $\alpha >1$.
For $x\ne 0$, differentiation gives $f'(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(x)[\alpha |x|^{\alpha -1}\sin(\frac{1}{|x|^\beta})-\beta |x|^{\alpha -\beta -1}\cos(\frac{1}{|x|^\beta})]$.

If $\alpha >\beta +1$, then $\alpha -1>0$ and $\alpha -\beta -1>0$. The two terms are bounded in absolute value by $\alpha |x|^{\alpha -1}$ and $\beta |x|^{\alpha -\beta -1}$, so both tend to 0 and $f'(x)\to 0=f'(0)$.

If $1<\alpha \le \beta +1$, take $x_n=(\frac{1}{2\pi n})^{\frac{1}{\beta}}>0$. Then the sine term is 0 and the cosine term is 1, so $f'(x_n)=-\beta x_n^{\alpha -\beta -1}$. It equals $-\beta$ when the exponent is 0 and is unbounded when the exponent is negative.
Therefore, within the differentiable range, $f'$ is continuous at 0 exactly when $\alpha >\beta +1$.
pitfalls: looking only at $|x|^\alpha$ and forgetting that a difference quotient lowers the power by one
omitting $\operatorname{sgn}(x)$ or $\beta +1$ when differentiating the phase
claiming necessity from vague oscillation without sequences
confusing the conditions $\alpha >1$ and $\alpha >\beta +1$
solution.verification: For $(\alpha,\beta)=(2,1)$, the function is differentiable at 0 but $\alpha =\beta +1$, so its derivative is not continuous. For $(3,1), \alpha >\beta +1$ and the derivative is continuous, confirming that the thresholds differ.
solution.takeaway: After each difference quotient or phase differentiation, recompute the net power controlling the oscillation; the strongest amplification determines the critical exponent.
solution.extension: Replacing sine by cosine and redefining $f(0)$ appropriately produces a related classification problem for continuity, differentiability, and continuity of the derivative.
